title: So glad we booked this-thank you Andrew!
text:
This was such a great way to get an overall feel for Barcelona and I highly recommend. We scheduled our  2 hour tour for 3 PM on the day of our arrival. Unsure of how long it would take us to get to our hotel, etc., I definitely misjudged and we could’ve started earlier. 

That said we had a great afternoon with Andrew. He was so knowledgeable, casual, and interesting and took us all around the city. Fortunately, we had pre-booked tickets for Sagrada Familia the following day, and because of where Andrew took us, we subsequently returned to two or three other sites we might not have known abou

title: Great cruise tour
text: We did the two hour tour and it was very worth it. We got to stop and take pictures during the tour and see some main attractions in Barcelona. We did this on our cruise stop and still have time to explore the city more. Would recommend.

title: Great city tour
text: It was a windy day so we appreciated the lap blankets provided. Glad I had a hoodie and hat and could have used gloves. But in good weather it would have been just fine. The narration was informative and we appreciated a break stop half way through thank you.
